title: Portrait and Alibi
author: Gideon Ravensworth
blurb: Isandro Fairweather, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
